goal: Add deterministic Show more navigation to bounded Starlane Home widgets and make provider/network previews complete, recognisable, and artwork-safe.
success_criteria: Movie, TV, discovery, genre, network, and provider preview rows end with a selectable Show more card that opens the same full source directory without creating a second Home renderer.
Continue Watching rows remain local-progress driven and do not display a misleading Show more card when the local queue is complete.
Provider previews include the major current streaming services and network previews include major channels before Show more; the full source list remains reachable.
Cards with missing remote artwork use a bounded local or existing Kodi fallback and remain visually/focus accessible.
Focused regression tests protect route identity, Show more placement/action, provider/network coverage, artwork fallback, one-renderer ownership, and resource bounds.
primary_hypothesis: Current rows expose raw provider directories whose pagination/folder entries are not rendered as a deliberate terminal action, while Providers uses Umbrella's three-item tvOriginals list rather than a complete ordered provider preview.
discriminating_check: Trace the generated widget content and provider directory output to identify whether truncation occurs in Skin Shortcuts, the Home list, or Umbrella, then prove the selected source-level terminal card opens the unchanged underlying directory.
stop_conditions: The implementation requires changing provider credentials, provider policy, or adding a third-party add-on.
The only feasible design creates parallel Home renderers or unbounded Home enumeration.
A required target route cannot be verified from staged provider source or existing regression evidence.
